recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑之間有多個大小不一的類上皮肉芽腫（左上、上方、右下），被帶狀纖維化與淋巴球浸潤的基質包圍、彼此鄰近融合，未見乾酪樣壞死，符合類肉瘤病的多發性非乾酪性肉芽腫合併纖維化。
features: Multiple discrete, closely spaced granulomas between bony trabeculae
Granulomas composed of epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm; multinucleated forms suggested at top
Extensive intervening fibrosis with streaming spindle cells and scattered lymphocytes
Normal hematopoietic marrow largely replaced in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows several compact epithelioid granulomas located between bony trabeculae, set within a fibrotic stroma containing spindled fibroblasts and scattered lymphocytes. The granulomas consist of epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm without central caseous necrosis. Normal hematopoietic tissue is largely replaced in this field. Findings are consistent with multiple non-necrotizing granulomas with fibrosis, compatible with marrow sarcoidosis once infection is excluded by special stains and cultures.

ddx.vs: Mycobacterial granulomas frequently show caseous necrosis, and AFB stain, culture or PCR is required to exclude them regardless of morphology.
Fungal granulomas show organisms highlighted by GMS or PAS staining and may contain necrosis.
Hodgkin involvement shows fibrosis with scattered large CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells rather than pure epithelioid granulomas.
Drug-related granulomas are usually small and loose and are identified by clinical history rather than a distinct morphology.
